home.eyebrow: A private atlas for your travels
home.title: Turn your travels into a private atlas.
home.subtitle: Collect cities, light up countries, preserve photos and memories — without being tracked.
home.problemTitle: Travel memories rarely stay in one place.
home.problemText: They scatter across photos, notes, map pins, receipts, messages, and forgotten apps. The shape of a life in motion becomes hard to see, even when the places still matter.
home.valueTitle: A private archive for visited cities, countries, and collected territories.
home.value1Text: Mark the places you have lived, loved, passed through, and remembered.
home.value2Text: Watch countries and cities gather into a map that belongs only to you.
home.value3Text: Save quiet notes, dates, photos, and fragments without turning them into a feed.
home.value4Text: Keep the places you dream about close, without confusing them with where you have been.
home.difference: RICORTU is a private archive for the places that became part of you.
home.useTitle: Made for travelers who want memory, not performance.
home.use4: People who love maps and personal archives
home.previewTitle: Your places. Your memories. Your own atlas.
home.seoTitle: A personal travel map, kept close.
home.seoText: Save the cities you have visited, collect countries on your map, and keep notes and photos beside the places they belong to. RICORTU is a local-first travel memory app: your archive starts on your device, with no account to create.
home.waitlistText: RICORTU is preparing for release on iOS and Android. Join the waitlist for launch updates. Public downloads are not available yet.

privacy.label: Privacy policy
privacy.title: RICORTU Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how RICORTU collects, uses, stores, shares, and protects information when you use the RICORTU app, website, and related services.
privacy.s1Text: RICORTU is a private travel memory app for iOS and Android. The app helps users save visited places, countries, wish-list destinations, notes, photos, travel memories, and map-based place records.
privacy.s2Text: Depending on how you use RICORTU, we may collect or process:
s2Items: Travel memory data you create, such as visited cities, countries, wish-list destinations, travel dates, notes, map coordinates, and place records.
Photos you choose to attach to travel memories or feedback messages.
Photo and file metadata, such as timestamps, file type, file size, local file references, location metadata embedded in photos, and place associations.
Device or app instance identifiers used to support local data, feedback, troubleshooting, and future cloud archive features.
Feedback and support messages, including optional image attachments you choose to send.
Basic technical and diagnostic information provided by platform services, generated by app errors, or submitted with support requests.
Waitlist email addresses submitted through the RICORTU website.
RICORTU does not collect contacts, SMS messages, call logs, health data, or continuous GPS tracking data.
s3Items: Provide, operate, maintain, and improve RICORTU.
Let you create and manage your private travel atlas.
Save cities, countries, dates, notes, photos, wish-list destinations, and map-based records you choose to add.
Display maps, place search results, and geocoding results.
Provide limited local archive, backup preparation, or future cloud archive features where available.
Respond to feedback, support, privacy, and deletion requests.
Protect the app from abuse, errors, and service misuse.
Improve reliability and diagnose crashes or technical issues where such diagnostics are available.
Send waitlist or product updates if you asked to receive them.
We do not use your private travel records or photos for advertising profiles.
privacy.s4Text: RICORTU is not a GPS tracking app and does not continuously monitor your location. The app is based on places you choose to save, such as cities, countries, wish-list destinations, or map-based place records. If you use map display, place search, or geocoding features, selected place information, search queries, approximate map regions, coordinates, and technical request data may be processed by map providers such as Mapbox so that maps and search can work. If you import photos from your device, RICORTU may read location metadata embedded in those photos, only after you grant the required photo or media permissions and choose to use the photo import feature.
privacy.s5Text: You may choose to attach photos to travel memories. Photos stored only on your device are not automatically uploaded to RICORTU. Currently, regular memory photos are intended to stay on your device unless you explicitly use a feature that uploads them. If you send feedback with an image attachment, that attachment may be uploaded to our cloud storage so we can review your support request. If RICORTU later enables cloud photo archive, backup, or sync, uploaded photos and related metadata may be stored using our cloud providers, and the app will describe that feature before or when you enable it. RICORTU does not use your private photos for public galleries, advertising profiles, or sale to third parties.
privacy.s6Text: RICORTU currently works primarily as a local private travel archive and does not offer account creation or sign-in. There is no account-based cloud sync. If accounts or broader cloud archive features, including photo cloud archive, become available, we will update this Privacy Policy and related in-app disclosures before or when those features are offered. Photos remain on your device unless you explicitly choose an upload feature, such as feedback attachments.
privacy.s7Text: RICORTU may use third-party service providers to operate the app:
s7Items: Mapbox for maps, geocoding, map display, and place search.
Supabase for feedback storage, optional image attachments submitted with feedback, database infrastructure, storage infrastructure, and future cloud archive features.
Google Play and Google services for Android app distribution, app review, app integrity, platform functionality, crash reporting, and diagnostics where enabled.
These providers may process data according to their own privacy policies and terms. We use service providers to provide, protect, and improve RICORTU, not to sell your personal data.
privacy.s8Text: RICORTU is private by default. Your saved places, notes, photos, wish-list destinations, travel memories, and map-based records are not public unless you choose to export or share them. If you create a share card, export an image, save a file, or send content to another app or person, that exported copy is controlled by the destination app, service, or recipient.
privacy.s9Text: We retain personal data for as long as reasonably necessary to provide RICORTU, maintain local app functionality, provide customer support, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, prevent abuse, enforce terms, and protect service security. Local-only data stored on your device remains on that device until you delete the app, clear app data, or remove the content yourself. Feedback records and attachments may be retained as long as needed to review, respond to, and improve the app. Waitlist email addresses may be retained until you unsubscribe or request deletion.
privacy.s10Text: You can request deletion of feedback records, uploaded feedback attachments, waitlist information, or any cloud data associated with your email address by contacting privacy@ricortu.app. If you used RICORTU without signing in, provide any information that may help us identify your request, such as the email address used for feedback or waitlist submission, or state that you were a local-only user. If a version of RICORTU offers account or cloud archive features, you can request deletion of account or cloud data by contacting privacy@ricortu.app. If an in-app deletion option is available in your version, you may also use that option. Local-only data on your device can be deleted by removing the content in the app, clearing app data, or uninstalling the app. We aim to process deletion requests within 30 days unless we need to retain limited information for legal, security, fraud-prevention, abuse-prevention, or dispute-resolution reasons.
privacy.s11Text: We use reasonable technical and organizational safeguards designed to protect personal data, including access controls, encrypted network connections where applicable, and security practices offered by our service providers. However, no method of transmission, processing, or storage is completely secure. You are responsible for keeping your device, operating system, email account, and any account credentials if account features become available in the future secure.
privacy.s12Text: RICORTU is not designed for children under 13 or the minimum age required by local law to use online services without parental consent. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children below that age. If you believe that a child has provided personal data to RICORTU, contact privacy@ricortu.app so we can review the situation and delete the information where appropriate.
privacy.s13Text: RICORTU and its service providers may process, transfer, and store information in countries other than the country where you live. These countries may have data protection laws that differ from your local laws. Where required, we rely on appropriate safeguards for international data transfers, such as contractual protections or service provider transfer mechanisms.
privacy.s14Text: If you are in the European Economic Area, United Kingdom, or Switzerland, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, or object to processing of your personal data, and to request portability of your data. You may also have the right to withdraw consent where processing is based on consent and to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority. To exercise these rights, contact privacy@ricortu.app. We may need to verify your request before acting on it.
privacy.s15Text: RICORTU does not sell personal data. We do not sell your saved places, notes, photos, wish-list destinations, travel memories, account information, waitlist email address, or feedback data to advertisers, data brokers, or third parties.
privacy.s16Text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time as RICORTU evolves, as features change, or as legal requirements change. When we update the policy, we will revise the Last updated date above. If changes are material, we may provide additional notice through the app, website, or email where appropriate.
privacy.s17Text: For privacy questions, GDPR or data rights requests, or deletion requests, contact privacy@ricortu.app. For general support, contact support@ricortu.app. Please do not include sensitive information in email unless necessary for your request.

terms.label: Terms
terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms explain how RICORTU should be used as a private, local-first travel memory app for saved places, visited cities, personal notes, photos, and future destinations.
terms.s1Text: RICORTU is a private travel memory app for iOS and Android. It is not a travel agency, travel guide, navigation app, social network, safety tracker, or continuous GPS tracking service.
terms.s2Text: RICORTU is designed around a private archive that primarily lives on your device. Photos and memories stored only on your device are controlled by you and can be removed by deleting content in the app, clearing app data, or uninstalling the app.
terms.s3Text: You are responsible for the places, dates, notes, photos, wishlist destinations, and memories you add to RICORTU. You should only add content that you have the right to save, use, or share.
terms.s4Text: RICORTU may use services such as Mapbox, Supabase, Google Play, or Google services to provide maps, place search, feedback handling, app distribution, platform functionality, crash reporting, or diagnostics where enabled.
terms.s5Text: If you join the waitlist or send feedback, we may use your email address and message content to respond, improve the app, and send requested product updates. Feedback image attachments may be uploaded so we can review your request.
terms.s6Text: RICORTU should not be used for emergency support, live navigation, real-time location sharing, travel safety monitoring, or any situation where accurate location tracking is required.
terms.s7Text: RICORTU is private by default. Your saved places, notes, photos, wishlists, and memories are not public unless you choose to export or share them. Privacy and deletion requests can be sent to privacy@ricortu.app or support@ricortu.app.
terms.s8Text: RICORTU is evolving. Features may change, be added, or be removed. If account, cloud archive, or photo cloud archive features become available, related terms and privacy disclosures may be updated before or when those features are offered.
terms.s9Text: For support questions, contact support@ricortu.app. For privacy, GDPR, or data deletion questions, contact privacy@ricortu.app.
terms.s10Text: You may use RICORTU for your personal travel archive, subject to these terms and applicable law. Do not interfere with the service, bypass security controls, or use it to store or share content unlawfully. You retain rights to your own content. Sending a support attachment allows us to process it for your request; it does not give us permission to publish it.
terms.s11Text: The current app has no account system or account-based cloud sync. Keep separate copies of important photos and memories. Removing the app, clearing its data, losing a device or changing phones may result in loss of local content. Contact support if you need guidance before deleting the app.
terms.s12Text: RICORTU is being prepared for public release. Joining the waitlist does not guarantee access or a launch date, and launch pricing has not been announced. Maps and search results may contain errors or become unavailable. You can stop using RICORTU at any time. These terms do not exclude rights or remedies that cannot be excluded under applicable consumer law.

deleteAccount.label: Data rights
deleteAccount.title: Delete your RICORTU data
deleteAccount.intro: You can request deletion of waitlist information, feedback records, uploaded feedback attachments, or any cloud data associated with your email address.
deleteAccount.included1: Waitlist email information submitted through ricortu.app.
deleteAccount.included2: Feedback messages and support requests that can be associated with your email address.
deleteAccount.included3: Uploaded feedback image attachments, if you chose to send them.
deleteAccount.included4: Any future account, backup, or cloud archive data associated with your email address if those features become available.
deleteAccount.notIncludedTitle: What we cannot delete from our servers
deleteAccount.notIncluded1: Data stored only on your phone. To remove local-only data, delete the content in the app, clear app data, or uninstall RICORTU.
deleteAccount.notIncluded2: Images, exports, or share cards that you already saved, sent, or shared outside RICORTU.
deleteAccount.requestText: Email support@ricortu.app with the subject line Delete my RICORTU data. Include any information that may help us identify your request, such as the email address used for feedback or waitlist submission. If your archive was local-only, please say that as well.
deleteAccount.timeline: We aim to process deletion requests within 30 days unless limited retention is required for legal, security, abuse-prevention, fraud-prevention, or dispute-resolution reasons.
deleteAccount.faqLocalA: Photos, notes, places, and archive data stored only on your device are not automatically uploaded to RICORTU. Delete the content in the app, clear app data, or uninstall the app to remove local-only data.
deleteAccount.faqSyncedA: Waitlist records, feedback records, uploaded feedback attachments, and any future cloud archive records associated with your email address are deleted after we verify and process your request.

footer.text: A private atlas for the cities, countries, and memories that became part of your life.

support.metaDescription: Get help with RICORTU: local memories, photos, maps, changing phones, feedback and data deletion. Contact support@ricortu.app.
support.title: Here to help.
support.intro: Questions about your private travel atlas? Contact us for help with RICORTU on iOS and Android, or explore the answers below.
support.reportText: Tell us what happened, what you expected, and the steps that led to it. Include your device model, iOS or Android version, and the RICORTU version shown in Settings. A screenshot can help if you are comfortable sharing one.
support.sensitive: Remove private photos, precise places or other sensitive details from attachments unless they are needed to explain the problem. Support does not require a RICORTU account.
support.rightsText: For privacy questions or deletion of waitlist information, feedback or uploaded feedback attachments, contact our privacy address.

faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.accountA: No. The current app has no account or sign-in system. Your travel archive is primarily stored on your device.
faq.locationQ: Does RICORTU track where I go?
faq.locationA: RICORTU does not continuously track GPS location. You choose the places to save. Map display and place search can send queries and technical request data to the map provider.
faq.photosA: Your saved memories and photos are private by default. Regular memory photos stay on your device unless you explicitly use an upload feature. Images you attach to feedback may be uploaded so we can review your request.
faq.offlineA: Your archive is primarily stored locally. Maps, place search, sending feedback and joining the website waitlist may need an internet connection. We do not promise complete offline map coverage.
faq.backupQ: What if I change or lose my phone?
faq.backupA: The current app does not provide account-based cloud sync. Do not assume that your archive will appear on a new phone. Keep separate copies of important photos and memories, and contact support before removing the app or resetting your device if you need help.
faq.feedbackQ: What happens when I send feedback?
faq.feedbackA: Your message, diagnostic information included with it, and any image attachment you choose to send may be processed to answer your request and improve reliability. Avoid including unrelated personal information.
faq.deletionQ: How do I delete my data?
faq.deletionA: Remove local content on your device, clear app data or uninstall the app. To request deletion of waitlist details, feedback or uploaded feedback attachments, email privacy@ricortu.app with information that helps identify your submission. We aim to process requests within 30 days, subject to the exceptions in our privacy policy.
faq.releaseA: Public App Store and Google Play downloads are not available yet. Join the waitlist to hear about the release. Joining does not guarantee a testing place or a release date.
faq.priceA: Launch pricing has not been announced. Joining the waitlist is free and does not commit you to a purchase. We will explain pricing before any paid offer becomes available.
